title: Spark Pulse Recipe v2
description: Recipe format v2 - separates engine-neutral parameters from engine-specific launch details so one recipe can target several serving engines.

recipe_version.description: Schema version. Must be "2" for this format.

model.description: Default model id (HuggingFace repo id or local path). Overridable at deploy time.

description.description: Short description of what this recipe does.

engine.description: Preferred engine name (e.g. vllm, sglang). Omit to use the configured default engine.

constraints.description: Topology constraints enforced at plan time.

solo_only.description: This recipe can only run on a single node.

cluster_only.description: This recipe requires more than one node.

params.description: Engine-neutral parameters. Each engine maps these onto its own flags. Extra keys are allowed and passed through.

port.description: Listen port for the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

gpu_memory_utilization.description: Fraction of GPU memory to use.

engines.description: Per-engine overrides. The keys are engine names; a recipe runs only on the engines it lists (plus the generic path when it lists none).

image.description: Container image override. Defaults to the engine's own image.

mods.description: Engine mods to apply before serving (vLLM only today).

env.description: Extra environment variables for the container.

args.description: Engine-specific argument tail. May reference {params} placeholders.

command.description: Full command template for this engine, bypassing rendering.
Escape hatch: a full command template. Pins the recipe to one engine, so `engine` is required alongside it.
